Newton printed the hymn under Revelation 5. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

1Then I saw a scroll in the right hand of the One seated on the throne. It had writing on both sides and was sealed with seven seals. 2And I saw a mighty angel proclaiming in a loud voice, “Who is worthy to break the seals and open the scroll?” 3But no one in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or look inside it. 4And I began to weep bitterly, because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or look inside it. … 10 more verses REVELATION 5 · ITS FIRST VERSES · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ REVELATION 5
